lines.text: The brothers in Jerusalem welcomed Paul joyfully, and he told James and the elders what God had done among the Gentiles.
The elders said the thousands of Jewish believers thought Paul taught Jews among the Gentiles to forsake David.
The elders told Paul to purify himself with four men under a vow and pay their expenses.
Jews from Asia stirred up the crowd, seized Paul, and dragged him out of the synagogue.
The Roman commander arrested Paul, ordered him bound with two chains, and had him brought into the barracks.
